reviews.reviewText:
MCQs ke liye 'World of Education Sir Saqib' ki video dekh lein. Subjective/Practical topics included:
1. Insertion Sort.
2. Skip List.
3. AVL Trees construction.
4. Practical programs (Coding).
5. Finding errors in a program.
Papr bht easy tha binary tree AVL tree min heap max heap sy bhafa hua tha sbb
